news.title: IMC Trading opens IIT, BITS women students for trading & tech course
Electronic trading firm IMC has quadrupled headcount in London in two years

summary: IMC Trading is electronic trading platform, founded in 1989. Type: private company. About 1,300 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam-headquartered quant trading firm since 1989, staff from 70+ nationalities; English-language tech roles that all mention visa support.

culture.text: Quant researchers, engineers and traders working together, with machine learning and AI at the core of trading.
Staff mostly studied computer science, maths, economics and finance, at schools like TU Delft, UvA, UIUC and University of Chicago.
Describes a collaborative, high-performance culture and a commitment to giving back.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (IMC Trading B.V.).
All 3 current Amsterdam jobs here don't require Dutch and all mention visa or relocation support.
Roles draw about 131 LinkedIn applicants on average, so it is very competitive.

growth.text: Has quadrupled its London headcount in two years.
Says it has over 2,070 employees across 10 offices, trading on 120+ venues.

worth_knowing.text: Runs a trading and tech course for women students from IIT and BITS in India.
